label: Local Update
method: No Burlington/Halton item had a strong current hook, so the rail used a verified regional fallback when available. Fresh Hamilton-area news may replace an otherwise stale utility/service row.

fallbackPolicy.followUps: Fresh source updates to archived stories receive a priority bonus; unchanged old stories do not become new again.
fallbackPolicy.context: Existing Burlington News stories require a related current event, meaningful update, explicit context signal or anniversary before they can enter Local Update.

items.headline: Hamilton police: Pair Sought in Downtown Assault
items.shortHeadline: Hamilton police: Pair Sought in Downtown Assault
items.summary: Hamilton Police are seeking the public’s assistance in identifying two females wanted in connection with an assault that left a Hamilton woman with serious injuries.
